Quarter three coaching report

This report covers July through September for the nine clients on a written program. It is meant to be read once, argued with, and then acted on before the next block starts.

What the weekly summary says

The weekly summary counts sessions and nothing else.

How rest is scheduled

Rest days land on Sunday for everybody, whatever their week looked like.

Check-in reminders

Everyone gets the same three reminders a week regardless of how often they train.

Adherence over the quarter

Questions go to the coach who wrote the program, not to the person who compiled this file.
